title: Multiple JOINs — Order with Customer, Product, and Supplier
description: Join four tables to get complete order information with customer, product, and supplier details.

data.text: Write a query to list each order line showing order date, customer name, product name, supplier name, quantity, and total amount.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    o.OrderID,
    o.OrderDate,
    c.CustomerName,
    p.ProductName,
    s.SupplierName,
    od.Quantity,
    od.UnitPrice,
    od.Quantity * od.UnitPrice AS LineTotal
FROM Orders o
INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
INNER JOIN OrderDetails od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID
INNER JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID
INNER JOIN Suppliers s ON p.SupplierID = s.SupplierID
ORDER BY o.OrderDate DESC, o.OrderID;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: Chain INNER JOINs to traverse relationships. Each join links one table to the next via a foreign key. Be mindful of the join order — start from the central fact table (Orders) and fan out to dimension tables.
